terminals.name: scout-workspace
terminals.command: source ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null; cd "${SCOUT_CLI_ROOT:-.}" && (test -d .venv || uv venv --python 3.11 .venv); printf '\n[ready] SCOUT_CLI_ROOT=%s\n' "${SCOUT_CLI_ROOT:-$(pwd)}"
terminals.description: Load scout-cli shell env and ensure a local venv exists.
